acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, bulbous, cauliflower-like growths on the distal ends of both claspers. These lesions exhibit a high-frequency rugose texture and a pale-gray to white color gradient. A thin, linear, high-luminance mark is also visible on the ventral surface leading toward the right clasper base.
other_distinctive_markers: The image captures a ventral view of a mature male specimen with fully developed claspers. The primary distinctive marker is the severe pathological tissue proliferation or atypical growth at the terminal points of the reproductive organs.
